result:
This confirms via the build already — the redirect, sitemap, and blog system all compiled and generated correctly. Here's a summary of what changed and why.

## Diagnosis

The business pivoted from **InboxZap** (an email-cleanup tool) to **Lumina** (an AI meeting assistant), but the migration left the codebase in a broken state:
- `app/layout.tsx` still carried InboxZap's title/description/OG tags even though the homepage content is 100% Lumina — a mismatched-metadata bug that sends confusing signals to Google and searchers.
- `/features` and `/pricing` were live/indexed in production but **missing from the repo** entirely.
- The blog was client-side rendered, fetching from a `/api/posts` route that doesn't exist — invisible to crawlers, no metadata, no per-post routes.
- All 12 existing blog posts (and 100% of GSC's query volume) are leftover InboxZap content — "bulk delete emails," "Gmail storage," "unsubscribe," etc. Thousands of impressions, near-0% CTR, position 40-60 — stale topical authority nobody relevant to Lumina will ever click through and convert on.
- `sitemap.ts` had a literal `// TODO` skipping blog posts; nav/footer linked to `/faq`, which 404'd.

## Changes made
- **`app/layout.tsx` / `app/page.tsx`** — fixed metadata to Lumina branding, added `Organization`/`SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD, canonical tag, internal links to features/pricing/blog.
- **`app/features/page.tsx`, `app/pricing/page.tsx`** — added to source (previously only existed in production, not in the repo), with proper metadata + internal linking.
- **`app/faq/page.tsx`** — real FAQ content with `FAQPage` JSON-LD (good for rich results/AI Overviews), including a "What happened to InboxZap?" answer to capture residual brand-name search intent without resurrecting irrelevant content.
- **Blog rebuilt as SSR**: `lib/posts.ts` + `app/blog/page.tsx` + `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`, fully static (`generateStaticParams`), each post with its own title/description/canonical/OG/`BlogPosting` schema. Seeded with 3 new posts targeting Lumina's actual audience (meeting notes, action-item tracking, async standups) instead of the dead InboxZap topics.
- **`next.config.js`** — 301-redirect the 12 legacy `/blog/post-N` URLs to `/blog` (preserves some link equity, stops diluting topical relevance) instead of the old dead `/faq → /#faq` redirect.
- **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now includes features, pricing, faq, and every real blog post with `lastModified`.

Verified with a full `next build` — all routes compile and prerender statically, metadata/schema render correctly in the output HTML.

**Not done, worth a decision from you:** the 3 seed blog posts are a starting content strategy, not a full calendar — I'd recommend treating "meeting productivity for remote/distributed teams" as the ongoing content lane. Also noticed in passing: `next@14.2.5` has a known security advisory (unrelated to SEO) — worth a dependency bump separately.
